author: BbPF
content: Plan: REQ-3 lock 1 shadow flag. manifest.rs adds BvShadow {flagged, semantics, nowrap_obligation, note} (RFC §9) as additive serde-default Option field on ObligationResult + with_bv_shadow builder + oracle_subset inclusion (Q-ORACLE precedent). check.rs attaches it to every tagged-clause obligation (proved/counterexample/timeout/skip), untagged clauses unchanged. review.rs and audit.rs gain an additive bv_shadows listing (burned_lemmas/lean_fragment precedent); cli.rs renders both. nowrap_obligation stays None until REQ-5. Tests: serde round-trip, oracle inclusion, grep-completeness, review/audit listing.
